title: Legacy S/370 versus ELF SDK z/OS profiles
summary: Historical MVS remains cfront -> cc370, with ELF SDK GCC as a separated research alternative. Mainframe ELF SDK 0.1.0 (GCC16.2, binutils2.47, selected newlib) supports TSO31 and TSO24 installed C consumers. Its 0.1.0 TSO24 service and dataset I/O are not MVS 3.8J qualified; SDK is C-only, so cfront remains the C++ lowering frontend initially.
invariants: Keep host compiler backend and guest runtime adapters independent.
Do not relabel profile objects to bypass MLAB1 ABI/service identity checks.
TSO31 ILP32 does not imply its runtime can be executed on MVS 3.8J.
The installed SDK reports upstream z/OS1.5 TSO31 entry plus selected dataset I/O, but our ooRexx SDK consumer has not been run with actual SDK.
TSO24 dataset I/O is excluded by SDK 0.1.0; do not substitute native entry24 for ooRexx's RecordSet support.
dev21 host pass is accepted only when the SDK result.json, actual ELF/native deck/XMIT digests, expected native member and AMODE/RMODE match; this is still a host-only result.
